Energy Markets · Operator Interface · shows what the backend publishes; commands go only through the backend. Every dotted value opens its provenance. Keys: 1–4 workspaces · ? semantics key · Esc close.

Semantics key

one visual grammar, all four workspaces
T₀ · decision-timeWhat the system knew at the decision instant. Slate blue, solid.
ExecutionAfter T₀, before evaluation: actuations and fills. Neutral ink.
Later · evaluationHindsight. Ochre on hatched paper; never drawn inside a T₀ panel.
UNKNOWNValue absent. Never shown as blank, zero or a guess. Plum hatch.
NOT CLOSEDExists but not final yet (e.g. evaluation still open). Dashed.
EVIDENCEReceipts, results, checks. Informs; never approves.
AUTHORITYA decision owner's recorded act. Double rule. Only place “approved” can appear.
◆ ▲ ■ ●Recommendation · Requested action · Execution/fill · Outcome — four separate objects, never merged.
